projectId.description: The project ID to which the hosting order is associated.

hostingOrderId.description: The unique ID of the hosting order.

displayName.description: The friendly name of the hosting order.

regionCode.description: The region code of the hosting order. Number hosting is only available for the US and Canada, so you must enter either "US" or "CA".

x-enumDescriptions.WAITING_FOR_LOA_SIGNATURE: Hosting order is waiting for the LoA signature.

state.description: The state of the hosting order.

x-enumDescriptions.HOSTING_ORDER_TYPE_UNSPECIFIED: The type of hosting order is unspecified.

createdTime.description: Timestamp when the hosting order was created

updatedTime.description: Timestamp when the hosting order was last updated

scheduledOsrUpdateTime.description: Timestamp when the OSR update will be done

servicePlanId.description: The service plan to which the hosting order is associated.

campaignId.description: The campaign to which the hosting order is associated.

migrateToSinchTmo.description: Displays if a number is assigned to another aggregator in T-Mobile's platform, and requires migration from previous aggregator to Sinch.

callbackUrl.description: The client's callback URL to be called upon finishing the number import.

buildingNumber.description: The building number of the address.

street.description: The street name of the address.

city.description: The city name of the address.

state.description: The state name of the address.

postalCode.description: The postal code of the address.

AuthorizedPerson.description: The person authorized and responsible for the hosting order.

firstName.description: The first name of the authorized person.

lastName.description: The last name of the authorized person.

email.description: The email address of the authorized person.

currentVoiceCarrier.description: The current carrier you are using for voice services for the number you want to host on Sinch.

nnid.description: The Net Number ID for the number you want to host on Sinch.

loaType.description: The type of the letter of authorization.

x-enumDescriptions.Direct: If you are a direct Sinch customer.
x-enumDescriptions.Reseller: If you are a Sinch partner or reseller.
